v.t: Praise be to God, to Whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; and praise be to Him in the Hereafter. He is the Wise, the Expert
v.l: Al-Hamdu Lillahi Al-Ladhi Lahu Ma Fi As-Samawati Wa Ma Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Lahu Al-Hamdu Fi Al-'Akhirati Wa Huwa Al-Hakimu Al-Khabiru

v.t: He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes out of it, and what descends from the sky, and what ascends to it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving
v.l: Ya`lamu Ma Yaliju Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Ma Yakhruju Minha Wa Ma Yanzilu Mina As-Sama'i Wa Ma Ya`ruju Fiha Wa Huwa Ar-Rahimu Al-Ghafuru

v.t: Those who disbelieve say, “The Hour will not come upon us.” Say, “Yes indeed, by my Lord, it will come upon you. He is the Knower of the unseen.” Not an atom's weight in the heavens and the earth, or anything smaller or larger, escapes His knowledge. All are in a Clear Record
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru La Ta'tina As-Sa`atu Qul Bala Wa Rabbi Lata'tiyannakum `Alimi Al-Ghaybi La Ya`zubu `Anhu Mithqalu Dharratin Fi As-Samawati Wa La Fi Al-'Arđi Wa La 'Asgharu Min Dhalika Wa La 'Akbaru 'Illa Fi Kitabin Mubinin
w: surely it will come to you

v.t: That He may recompense those who believe and do good works. Those will have forgiveness, and a generous provision
v.l: Liyajziya Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati 'Ula'ika Lahum Maghfiratun Wa Rizqun Karimun

v.t: As for those who strive against Our revelations, seeking to undermine them—for them is a punishment of a painful plague
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Sa`aw Fi 'Ayatina Mu`ajizina 'Ula'ika Lahum `Adhabun Min Rijzin 'Alimun

v.t: Those who received knowledge know that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth; and it guides to the path of the Majestic, the Praiseworthy
v.l: Wa Yara Al-Ladhina 'Utu Al-`Ilma Al-Ladhi 'Unzila 'Ilayka Min Rabbika Huwa Al-Haqqa Wa Yahdi 'Ila Sirati Al-`Azizi Al-Hamidi

v.t: Those who disbelieved said, “Shall we point out to you a man, who will tell you that, once torn into shreds, you will be in a new creation
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru Hal Nadullukum `Ala Rajulin Yunabbi'ukum 'Idha Muzziqtum Kulla Mumazzaqin 'Innakum Lafi Khalqin Jadidin

v.t: Did he invent a lie about God, or is there madness in him?” Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are in torment, and far astray
v.l: Aftara `Ala Allahi Kadhibaan 'Am Bihi Jinnatun Bali Al-Ladhina La Yu'uminuna Bil-'Akhirati Fi Al-`Adhabi Wa Ađ-Đalali Al-Ba`idi

v.t: Do they not reflect upon what lies before them and behind them, of the heaven and the earth? If We will, We can make the earth cave in beneath them, or make pieces of the sky fall down on them. In that is a sign for every devout servant
v.l: Afalam Yaraw 'Ila Ma Bayna 'Aydihim Wa Ma Khalfahum Mina As-Sama'i Wa Al-'Arđi 'In Nasha' Nakhsif Bihimu Al-'Arđa 'Aw Nusqit `Alayhim Kisafaan Mina As-Sama'i 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatan Likulli `Abdin Munibin

v.t: We bestowed upon David favor from Us: “O mountains, and birds: echo with him.” And We softened iron for him
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Dawuda Minna Fađlaan Ya Jibalu 'Awwibi Ma`ahu Wa At-Tayra Wa 'Alanna Lahu Al-Hadida

v.t: “Make coats of armor, and measure the links well; and work righteousness. I am Observant of everything you do.”
v.l: Ani A`mal Sabighatin Wa Qaddir Fi As-Sardi Wa A`malu Salihaan 'Inni Bima Ta`maluna Basirun

v.t: And for Solomon the wind—its outward journey was one month, and its return journey was one month. And We made a spring of tar flow for him. And there were sprites that worked under him, by the leave of his Lord. But whoever of them swerved from Our command, We make him taste of the punishment of the Inferno
v.l: Wa Lisulaymana Ar-Riha Ghuduwuha Shahrun Wa Rawahuha Shahrun Wa 'Asalna Lahu `Ayna Al-Qitri Wa Mina Al-Jinni Man Ya`malu Bayna Yadayhi Bi'idhni Rabbihi Wa Man Yazigh Minhum `An 'Amrina Nudhiqhu Min `Adhabi As-Sa`iri

v.t: They made for him whatever he wished: sanctuaries, statues, bowls like pools, and heavy cauldrons. “O House of David, work with appreciation,” but a few of My servants are appreciative
v.l: Ya`maluna Lahu Ma Yasha'u Min Mahariba Wa Tamathila Wa Jifanin Kaljawabi Wa Qudurin Rasiyatin A`malu 'Ala Dawuda Shukraan Wa Qalilun Min `Ibadiya Ash-Shakuru

v.t: Then, when We decreed death for him, nothing indicated his death to them except an earthworm eating at his staff. Then, when he fell down, it became clear to the sprites that, had they known the unseen, they would not have remained in the demeaning torment
v.l: Falamma Qađayna `Alayhi Al-Mawta Ma Dallahum `Ala Mawtihi 'Illa Dabbatu Al-'Arđi Ta'kulu Minsa'atahu Falamma Kharra Tabayyanati Al-Jinnu 'An Law Kanu Ya`lamuna Al-Ghayba Ma Labithu Fi Al-`Adhabi Al-Muhini

v.t: In Sheba’s homeland there used to be a wonder: two gardens, on the right, and on the left. “Eat of your Lord’s provision, and give thanks to Him.” A good land, and a forgiving Lord
v.l: Laqad Kana Lisaba'iin Fi Maskanihim 'Ayatun Jannatani `An Yaminin Wa Shimalin Kulu Min Rizqi Rabbikum Wa Ashkuru Lahu Baldatun Tayyibatun Wa Rabbun Ghafurun

v.t: But they turned away, so We unleashed against them the flood of the dam; and We substituted their two gardens with two gardens of bitter fruits, thorny shrubs, and meager harvest
v.l: Fa'a`rađu Fa'arsalna `Alayhim Sayla Al-`Arimi Wa Baddalnahum Bijannatayhim Jannatayni Dhawata 'Ukulin Khamtin Wa 'Athlin Wa Shay'in Min Sidrin Qalilin

v.t: We thus penalized them for their ingratitude. Would We penalize any but the ungrateful
v.l: Dhalika Jazaynahum Bima Kafaru Wa Hal Nujazi 'Illa Al-Kafura

v.t: Between them and the towns We had blessed, We placed prominent towns, and We made the travel between them easy. “Travel between them by night and day, in safety.”
v.l: Wa Ja`alna Baynahum Wa Bayna Al-Qura Allati Barakna Fiha Quraan Zahiratan Wa Qaddarna Fiha As-Sayra Siru Fiha Layaliya Wa 'Ayyamaan 'Aminina

v.t: But they said, “Our Lord, lengthen the distances of our journeys.” They wronged themselves; so We made them history, and We scattered them in every direction. In this are lessons for every steadfast and appreciative person
v.l: Faqalu Rabbana Ba`id Bayna 'Asfarina Wa Zalamu 'Anfusahum Faja`alnahum 'Ahaditha Wa Mazzaqnahum Kulla Mumazzaqin 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Likulli Sabbarin Shakurin

v.t: Satan was correct in his assessment of them. They followed him, except for a group of believers
v.l: Wa Laqad Saddaqa `Alayhim 'Iblisu Zannahu Fa Attaba`uhu 'Illa Fariqaan Mina Al-Mu'uminina

v.t: He had no authority over them; except that We willed to distinguish him who believes in the Hereafter, from him who is doubtful about it. Your Lord is Guardian over all things
v.l: Wa Ma Kana Lahu `Alayhim Min Sultanin 'Illa Lina`lama Man Yu'uminu Bil-'Akhirati Mimman Huwa Minha Fi Shakkin Wa Rabbuka `Ala Kulli Shay'in Hafizun

v.t: Say, “Call upon those whom you claim besides God. They possess not an atom's weight in the heavens or the earth, and they possess no share of either, and He has no backers from among them.”
v.l: Qul Ad`u Al-Ladhina Za`amtum Min Duni Allahi La Yamlikuna Mithqala Dharratin Fi As-Samawati Wa La Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Ma Lahum Fihima Min Shirkin Wa Ma Lahu Minhum Min Zahirin

v.t: Intercession with Him is of no value, except for someone He has permitted. Until, when fear has subsided from their hearts, they will say, “What did your Lord say?” They will say, “The truth, and He is the High, the Great.”
v.l: Wa La Tanfa`u Ash-Shafa`atu `Indahu 'Illa Liman 'Adhina Lahu Hatta 'Idha Fuzzi`a `An Qulubihim Qalu Madha Qala Rabbukum Qalu Al-Haqqa Wa Huwa Al-`Aliyu Al-Kabiru

v.t: Say, “Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “God. And Either you, or we, are rightly guided, or in evident error.”
v.l: Qul Man Yarzuqukum Mina As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Quli Allahu Wa 'Inna 'Aw 'Iyakum La`ala Hudaan 'Aw Fi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: Say, “You will not be asked about our misdeeds, nor will we be asked about what you do.”
v.l: Qul La Tus'aluna `Amma 'Ajramna Wa La Nus'alu `Amma Ta`maluna

v.t: Say, “Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us equitably. He is the All-Knowing Judge.”
v.l: Qul Yajma`u Baynana Rabbuna Thumma Yaftahu Baynana Bil-Haqqi Wa Huwa Al-Fattahu Al-`Alimu

v.t: Say, “Show me those you have attached to Him as associates. No indeed! But He is God, the Powerful, the Wise.”
v.l: Qul 'Aruniya Al-Ladhina 'Alhaqtum Bihi Shuraka'a Kalla Bal Huwa Allahu Al-`Azizu Al-Hakimu

v.t: We sent you only universally to all people, a herald and warner, but most people do not know
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalnaka 'Illa Kaffatan Lilnnasi Bashiraan Wa Nadhiraan Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: And they say, “When is this promise due, if you are truthful?”
v.l: Wa Yaquluna Mata Hadha Al-Wa`du 'In Kuntum Sadiqina

v.t: Say, “You are promised a Day, which you cannot postpone by one hour, nor bring forward.”
v.l: Qul Lakum Mi`adu Yawmin La Tasta'khiruna `Anhu Sa`atan Wa La Tastaqdimuna

v.t: Those who disbelieve say, “We will never believe in this Quran, nor in what came before it.” If you could only see the wrongdoers, captive before their Lord, throwing back allegations at one another. Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, “Were it not for you, we would have been believers.”
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru Lan Nu'umina Bihadha Al-Qur'ani Wa La Bial-Ladhi Bayna Yadayhi Wa Law Tara 'Idhi Az-Zalimuna Mawqufuna `Inda Rabbihim Yarji`u Ba`đuhum 'Ila Ba`đin Al-Qawla Yaqulu Al-Ladhina Astuđ`ifu Lilladhina Astakbaru Lawla 'Antum Lakunna Mu'uminina

v.t: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, “Was it us who turned you away from guidance when it came to you? No indeed, you yourselves were sinful.”
v.l: Qala Al-Ladhina Astakbaru Lilladhina Astuđ`ifu 'Anahnu Sadadnakum `Ani Al-Huda Ba`da 'Idh Ja'akum Bal Kuntum Mujrimina

v.t: And those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, “It was your scheming by night and day; as you instructed us to reject God, and to set up rivals to Him.” They will hide their remorse when they see the retribution. We will put yokes around the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be repaid for anything other than what they used to do
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Astuđ`ifu Lilladhina Astakbaru Bal Makru Al-Layli Wa An-Nahari 'Idh Ta'murunana 'An Nakfura Billahi Wa Naj`ala Lahu 'Andadaan Wa 'Asarru An-Nadamata Lamma Ra'aw Al-`Adhaba Wa Ja`alna Al-'Aghlala Fi 'A`naqi Al-Ladhina Kafaru Hal Yujzawna 'Illa Ma Kanu Ya`maluna

v.t: We sent no warner to any town, without its affluent saying, “We reject what you are sent with.”
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalna Fi Qaryatin Min Nadhirin 'Illa Qala Mutrafuha 'Inna Bima 'Ursiltum Bihi Kafiruna

v.t: And they say, “We have more wealth and more children, and we will not be punished.”
v.l: Wa Qalu Nahnu 'Aktharu 'Amwalaan Wa 'Awladaan Wa Ma Nahnu Bimu`adhabina

v.t: Say, “My Lord spreads out His bounty to whomever He wills, or restricts it; but most people do not know.”
v.l: Qul 'Inna Rabbi Yabsutu Ar-Rizqa Liman Yasha'u Wa Yaqdiru Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: It is neither your wealth nor your children that bring you closer to Us, but it is he who believes and does good deeds. These will have a double reward for what they did; and they will reside in the Chambers, in peace and security
v.l: Wa Ma 'Amwalukum Wa La 'Awladukum Bi-Ati Tuqarribukum `Indana Zulfa 'Illa Man 'Amana Wa `Amila Salihaan Fa'ula'ika Lahum Jaza'u Ađ-Đi`fi Bima `Amilu Wa Hum Fi Al-Ghurufati 'Aminuna

v.t: But those who work against Our revelations, seeking to undermine them—those will be summoned to the punishment
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Yas`awna Fi 'Ayatina Mu`ajizina 'Ula'ika Fi Al-`Adhabi Muhđaruna

v.t: Say, “My Lord extends the provision to whomever He wills of His servants, or withholds it. Anything you spend, He will replace it. He is the Best of providers.”
v.l: Qul 'Inna Rabbi Yabsutu Ar-Rizqa Liman Yasha'u Min `Ibadihi Wa Yaqdiru Lahu Wa Ma 'Anfaqtum Min Shay'in Fahuwa Yukhlifuhu Wa Huwa Khayru Ar-Raziqina

v.t: On the Day when He gathers them all together, then say to the angels, “Was it you these used to worship?”
v.l: Wa Yawma Yahshuruhum Jami`aan Thumma Yaqulu Lilmala'ikati 'Aha'uula' 'Iyakum Kanu Ya`buduna

v.t: They will say, “Be You glorified; You are our Master, not them. In fact, they used to worship the jinn, and most of them had faith in them.”
v.l: Qalu Subhanaka 'Anta Waliyuna Min Dunihim Bal Kanu Ya`buduna Al-Jinna 'Aktharuhum Bihim Mu'uminuna

v.t: “Today, none of you has the power to profit or harm the other.” And We will say to those who did wrong, “Taste the agony of the Fire which you used to deny.”
v.l: Falyawma La Yamliku Ba`đukum Liba`đin Naf`aan Wa La Đarraan Wa Naqulu Lilladhina Zalamu Dhuqu `Adhaba An-Nari Allati Kuntum Biha Tukadhibun

v.t: And when Our enlightening Verses are recited to them, they say, “This is nothing but a man who wants to divert you from what your ancestors used to worship.” And they say, “This is nothing but a fabricated lie.” And when the Truth comes to them, the blasphemers say of the Truth, “This is nothing but plain magic.”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Tutla `Alayhim 'Ayatuna Bayyinatin Qalu Ma Hadha 'Illa Rajulun Yuridu 'An Yasuddakum `Amma Kana Ya`budu 'Aba'uukum Wa Qalu Ma Hadha 'Illa 'Ifkun Muftaraan Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru Lilhaqqi Lamma Ja'ahum 'In Hadha 'Illa Sihrun Mubinun

v.t: But We gave them no book to study, and We did not send them any warner before you
v.l: Wa Ma 'Ataynahum Min Kutubin Yadrusunaha Wa Ma 'Arsalna 'Ilayhim Qablaka Min Nadhirin

v.t: Those before them also denied the Truth, yet they have not attained one-tenth of what We had given them. They rejected My messengers, so how was My disapproval
v.l: Wa Kadhaba Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Wa Ma Balaghu Mi`shara Ma 'Ataynahum Fakadhabu Rusuli Fakayfa Kana Nakiri

v.t: Say, “I offer you a single advice: devote yourselves to God, in pairs, or individually; and reflect. There is no madness in your friend. He is just a warner to you, before the advent of a severe punishment.”
v.l: Qul 'Innama 'A`izukum Biwahidatin 'An Taqumu Lillahi Mathna Wa Furada Thumma Tatafakkaru Ma Bisahibikum Min Jinnatin 'In Huwa 'Illa Nadhirun Lakum Bayna Yaday `Adhabin Shadidin

v.t: Say, “Whatever compensation I have asked of you, is yours. My compensation comes only from God, and He is Witness over all things.”
v.l: Qul Ma Sa'altukum Min 'Ajrin Fahuwa Lakum 'In 'Ajriya 'Illa `Ala Allahi Wa Huwa `Ala Kulli Shay'in Shahidun

v.t: Say, “My Lord projects the truth. He is the Knower of the Unseen.”
v.l: Qul 'Inna Rabbi Yaqdhifu Bil-Haqqi `Allamu Al-Ghuyubi

v.t: Say, “The Truth has come; while falsehood can neither originate, nor regenerate.”
v.l: Qul Ja'a Al-Haqqu Wa Ma Yubdi'u Al-Batilu Wa Ma Yu`idu

v.t: Say, “If I err, I err only to my own loss; but if I am guided, it is by what my Lord inspires me. He is Hearing and Near.”
v.l: Qul 'In Đalaltu Fa'innama 'Ađillu `Ala Nafsi Wa 'Ini Ahtadaytu Fabima Yuhi 'Ilayya Rabbi 'Innahu Sami`un Qaribun

v.t: If you could only see when they are terrified, and there is no escape, and they are seized from a nearby place
v.l: Wa Law Tara 'Idh Fazi`u Fala Fawta Wa 'Ukhidhu Min Makanin Qaribin

v.t: And they say, “We have believed in it.” But how can they attain it from a distant place
v.l: Wa Qalu 'Amanna Bihi Wa 'Anna Lahumu At-Tanawushu Min Makanin Ba`idin

v.t: They have rejected it in the past, and made allegations from a far-off place
v.l: Wa Qad Kafaru Bihi Min Qablu Wa Yaqdhifuna Bil-Ghaybi Min Makanin Ba`idin

v.t: A barrier will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done formerly with their counterparts. They were in disturbing doubt
v.l: Wa Hila Baynahum Wa Bayna Ma Yashtahuna Kama Fu`ila Bi'ashya`ihim Min Qablu 'Innahum Kanu Fi Shakkin Muribin
w: And a barrier will be placed
